messages:
sam_finance: FYI - spotted a weird line on the March GCP invoice: 'Metadata Service - Network Egress' ~ $12,400 billed to project redwood-inference-prod. Anyone seen metadata egress billed before?

jordan_ops: Huh, metadata egress doesn't make sense. That IP (169.254.169.254) is link-local. Can you paste the raw billing row?

sam_finance: Pasting the billing export CSV row we pulled: `service=Compute Engine, sku=Metadata Service (Network Egress), usage_start=2025-03-12, cost_usd=12400.00, project=redwood-inference-prod, region=us-central1, labels=[env:prod, component:metadata-proxy]`

lee_infra: Metadata traffic shouldn't leave the VPC. My first guess: a proxy or NAT misconfiguration forwarded metadata requests to a public IP. Will check recent deploys to metadata-proxy.

emily_billing: I've flagged to GCP support but let's triage internally first. @ops-bot can you collect VPC Flow Logs for redwood-inference-prod for 2025-03-12 00:00-06:00 UTC?

ops-bot: Run queued: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gce_instance" AND logName="projects/redwood-inference-prod/logs/compute.googleapis.com%2Fvpc_flows"' --start-time=2025-03-12T00:00:00Z --end-time=2025-03-12T06:00:00Z --limit=5000` Output will be posted in thread.

jordan_ops: Quick grep on those logs shows repeated flows from internal instance ip 10.128.5.12 -> 34.12.34.56 port 80, labeled as EGRESS. 34.12.34.56 is not ours (belongs to different org/project). Looks like metadata-proxy did an external forward.

lee_infra: Found the config change from last week (rollback attempt) where a temporary upstream was set. Snippet: 
```
frontend md_front
  bind *:80
  mode tcp
  default_backend md_back
backend md_back
  server temp-upstream 34.12.34.56:80 check
```
This was part of fix for a broken internal metadata mirror — someone pointed the upstream to a public IP.

anna_cost: Invoice labels show `component=metadata-proxy`. So billing export linked the egress to our metadata-proxy resource. That matches the flow logs.

emily_billing: GCP support case opened: 6789012345. Shared logs + config + firewall rules. Requested a review for misattributed charges due to configuration error. They asked for ownership proof of the dest IP if we want full reversal.

jordan_ops: Mitigation performed: removed the public upstream, re-pointed to internal metadata mirror, added firewall egress deny for 34.12.34.56, and reverted deploy cd-20250305.

lee_infra: Also added a quick sniff to detect future metadata requests hitting public IPs: `sudo tcpdump -n -i any host 34.12.34.56 and port 80` on the proxy nodes (short-term) and a permanent alert in infra.

sam_finance: Emily, any update on the refund chances? If GCP considers this 'customer misconfig' they might deny reversal.

emily_billing: We pushed for a credit given the metadata label and obvious misconfiguration. GCP acknowledged the ticket and escalated; preliminary reply: under review, ETA 7-10 business days. I've requested at least a partial credit for 2025-03-10..14.

ops-bot: Alert created: `budget.metadata-egress` threshold $1000/day -> channels: #eng-infra, #finance.

anna_cost: In parallel I'm running a query over billing_export.table to find any other 'Metadata Service' SKU hits in last 12 months. Initial scan shows zero prior to March 2025 for this project.

lee_infra: Action items: 1) sweep for any proxies with upstreams pointing to public IPs (I own) 2) enforce egress firewall deny by default for metadata-proxy (jordan owns) 3) add infra test that metadata endpoints resolve to internal addresses (lee owns) - ETA EOD tomorrow.

sam_finance: Marking as P1 billing anomaly. I'll brief leadership and log expected credit action. Keep this thread updated.

jordan_ops: :thumbsup:

emily_billing: Will post GCP case updates here. If support denies reversal we'll calculate exposure and propose a one-time cost recovery plan.

ops-bot: Case 6789012345 updated by emily_billing at 2025-03-14T18:32:00Z: "Escalated to billing team for review"

sam_finance: Thanks everyone — good catch.

(attachments: billing_export_row.csv snippet, flowlogs_sample.json, haproxy_conf.diff)
